title: QuadPay.Gateway.Orders.Commands.ConfirmOrder+Command
description: Used to confirm a previously authorized order and start the payment plan.

orderId.description: Gets or sets the Id of the Order.

amount.description:
Gets or sets an optional final amount, including tax and shipping, of the order to be confirmed.
If not supplied, the original order amount will be used.

shippingAmount.description: Gets or sets the optional shipping amount associated with the order.

taxAmount.description: Gets or sets? the optional tax amount associated with the order.

merchantReference.description: Gets or sets the Merchant Reference of the confirmation.

callbackUrl.description: Gets or sets the url to callback with the confirm result.

test.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether this is a test order.

capture.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether or not the order should be captured immediately after confirmation

metadata.description: Gets or sets optional metadata associated with this confirmation.

isSync.description: Get or sets a flag indicating whether or not to invoke this operation synchronously. Set to false by default.
